project.title: Spring campaign
project.description: Brand identity, website, launch assets, campaign toolkit, motion system and retail guidelines for the spring collection across UK and EU markets.

notes: Payment due within 30 days. Please quote the invoice number with your transfer.

qr.alt: QR code to pay invoice INV-2026-014

items.detail: Discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, category audit, positioning territories, messaging architecture, naming territories and a full verbal identity system for launch and rollout. The engagement covers discovery, stakeholder alignment, market review, naming, messaging, art direction, design systems, campaign production and launch support across UK and EU markets.

Creative direction, casting, location scouting, wardrobe, set design and on-set oversight for the campaign shoot and motion tests. The shoot covers studio and location setups, talent, wardrobe, props, motion tests and final selects for social, retail and out-of-home.

Logo, type system, colour palette, art direction, iconography and a full identity guideline covering print, retail and digital applications. Deliverables include master logo files, responsive lockups, colour tokens, type specimens, iconography and a full brand portal.

Editorial plan, tone of voice, campaign narrative, launch copy and a content calendar for the extended spring campaign across UK and EU markets. The programme includes editorial workshops, messaging testing, channel planning and a launch calendar.
Home, work, about, journal and contact pages, plus responsive templates for campaign landing pages, a reusable CMS component library and a design QA pass.
Responsive build, CMS setup, analytics, performance budget, accessibility checks, a launch checklist and a handover session for the client team.
Social templates, out-of-home artwork, retail POS, packaging inserts and print collateral for the launch window.
Two-day studio shoot, product still life, on-model imagery, art direction and final retouching.
Logo animation, title cards, social cutdowns, transition library and motion guidelines for the campaign toolkit.
Campaign headlines, product descriptions, email sequence, retail copy and a tone-of-voice guide.
Digital asset pack, brand templates, partner guidelines, a self-serve asset library and usage documentation.
Paid social, organic posts, stories, reel covers and launch-week scheduling templates.
Colour grading, skin retouching, product cleanup and final delivery masters.
On-set production support, asset coordination and final file delivery.
